# CNET
> CNET publishes expert product reviews, buying advice, how-tos, deals coverage and technology news for consumers.

CNET covers consumer technology, home products, internet services, personal finance-adjacent utility topics and practical advice. Its strongest resources are category hubs for reviews, best lists, explainers and news across tech, home, streaming, security and connectivity.

## Main Hubs
- [CNET Home](https://www.cnet.com/): Front page featuring latest reviews, news, advice and deals coverage.
- [Tech](https://www.cnet.com/tech/): Central hub for consumer technology news, reviews and buying guides.
- [Home](https://www.cnet.com/home/): Home-focused coverage spanning smart home, internet, security and appliances.
- [Deals](https://www.cnet.com/deals/): Curated daily deals, discounts and shopping recommendations across major retailers.
- [How To](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/how-to/): Practical tutorials and troubleshooting guides for apps, devices and online services.

## Mobile & Computing
- [Mobile](https://www.cnet.com/tech/mobile/): Phone news, reviews, carrier coverage and mobile buying advice.
- [Phones](https://www.cnet.com/tech/mobile/phones/): Smartphone reviews, best phone lists and feature comparisons.
- [Computing](https://www.cnet.com/tech/computing/): Laptop, desktop, tablet and PC accessory coverage.
- [Laptops](https://www.cnet.com/tech/computing/laptops/): Laptop reviews, recommendations and shopping advice for work and school.
- [Desktops](https://www.cnet.com/tech/computing/desktops/): Desktop PC reviews and buying guides for home, office and gaming.
- [Tablets](https://www.cnet.com/tech/computing/tablets/): Tablet reviews, comparisons and recommendations across major platforms.

## TV, Streaming & Entertainment
- [Home Entertainment](https://www.cnet.com/tech/home-entertainment/): TV, projector, audio and theater system reviews and explainers.
- [TVs](https://www.cnet.com/tech/home-entertainment/tvs/): Television reviews, calibration advice and best TV recommendations.
- [Audio](https://www.cnet.com/tech/home-entertainment/audio/): Headphone, speaker, soundbar and home audio coverage.
- [Streaming Services](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/streaming/): Streaming platform news, pricing updates and viewing guides.
- [Gaming](https://www.cnet.com/tech/gaming/): Console, PC and handheld gaming news, reviews and buying advice.

## Services, Software & Security
- [Services and Software](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/): Coverage of apps, software, subscriptions and digital services.
- [VPN](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/vpn/): VPN reviews, testing results and privacy-focused buying guides.
- [Antivirus](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/antivirus/): Antivirus software reviews and security recommendations.
- [Password Managers](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/password-managers/): Password manager comparisons, reviews and setup advice.
- [AI](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/ai/): News, explainers and practical guidance on consumer AI tools.
- [Privacy](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/privacy/): Privacy news, data protection tips and security explainers.

## Smart Home & Home Security
- [Smart Home](https://www.cnet.com/home/smart-home/): Smart home device reviews, setup guides and platform comparisons.
- [Home Security](https://www.cnet.com/home/security/): Security camera, video doorbell and alarm system reviews.
- [Cameras](https://www.cnet.com/home/security/cameras/): Home security camera reviews and buying recommendations.
- [Video Doorbells](https://www.cnet.com/home/security/video-doorbells/): Doorbell camera reviews, comparisons and installation advice.
- [Smart Lighting](https://www.cnet.com/home/smart-home/smart-lighting/): Smart bulb and lighting system reviews and setup guides.
- [Smart Speakers](https://www.cnet.com/home/smart-home/smart-speakers/): Smart speaker reviews and voice assistant buying advice.

## Internet, Mobile Carriers & Connectivity
- [Home Internet](https://www.cnet.com/home/internet/): ISP reviews, broadband comparisons and internet plan advice.
- [Best Internet Providers](https://www.cnet.com/home/internet/best-internet-providers/): Ranked recommendations for internet providers by speed, value and availability.
- [5G Home Internet](https://www.cnet.com/home/internet/5g-home-internet/): Coverage of fixed wireless internet plans, pricing and performance.
- [Mobile Carriers](https://www.cnet.com/tech/mobile/carriers/): Carrier plan comparisons, network updates and wireless advice.
- [Wi-Fi & Networking](https://www.cnet.com/home/internet/): Router, mesh Wi-Fi and home networking guidance within internet coverage.

## Appliances, Kitchen & Outdoor
- [Kitchen and Household](https://www.cnet.com/home/kitchen-and-household/): Appliance reviews, cleaning gear coverage and household buying guides.
- [Refrigerators](https://www.cnet.com/home/kitchen-and-household/refrigerators/): Refrigerator reviews, feature comparisons and shopping advice.
- [Coffee Makers](https://www.cnet.com/home/kitchen-and-household/coffee-makers/): Coffee maker reviews and recommendations for different budgets.
- [Air Fryers](https://www.cnet.com/home/kitchen-and-household/air-fryers/): Air fryer reviews, testing results and best picks.
- [Yard and Outdoors](https://www.cnet.com/home/yard-and-outdoors/): Outdoor gear, grills, lawn care and seasonal product guides.
- [Grills](https://www.cnet.com/home/yard-and-outdoors/grills/): Grill reviews, comparisons and outdoor cooking buying advice.

## Deals & Buying Advice
- [Deals](https://www.cnet.com/deals/): Daily deals coverage across tech, home, streaming and subscription products.
- [Best Lists](https://www.cnet.com/topics/): Topic-driven entry points to CNET reviews, recommendations and category coverage.
- [Gift Guides](https://www.cnet.com/deals/gift-guide/): Seasonal gift recommendations and curated shopping picks.
- [Amazon Deals](https://www.cnet.com/deals/amazon/): Amazon-focused discounts and shopping roundups.
- [Walmart Deals](https://www.cnet.com/deals/walmart/): Walmart sale coverage and featured product discounts.
- [Best VPN](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/best-vpn/): CNET’s top VPN recommendations based on testing and evaluation.

## News & Emerging Topics
- [News](https://www.cnet.com/news/): Broad news coverage across technology, science and consumer topics.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software/ai/): AI product news, explainers and consumer guidance.
- [Science](https://www.cnet.com/science/): Science and space news with practical and cultural relevance.
- [Climate](https://www.cnet.com/science/climate/): Climate technology, energy and sustainability reporting.
- [Space](https://www.cnet.com/science/space/): Space exploration news, launches and astronomy coverage.

## Reviews & Product Testing
- [Product Reviews](https://www.cnet.com/reviews/): Aggregated reviews across phones, TVs, appliances and services.
- [Best Products](https://www.cnet.com/topics/): Category pages surfacing best picks, reviews and explainers.
- [TV Reviews](https://www.cnet.com/tech/home-entertainment/tvs/): Television testing, side-by-side comparisons and recommendations.
- [Phone Reviews](https://www.cnet.com/tech/mobile/phones/): Smartphone reviews with camera, battery and performance analysis.
- [Laptop Reviews](https://www.cnet.com/tech/computing/laptops/): Laptop evaluations covering portability, performance and value.
- [Security System Reviews](https://www.cnet.com/home/security/): Reviews and comparisons for monitored and DIY home security systems.
